vqa_items.question: As an out-of-home transit-shelter advertisement, does the tall composition communicate one memorable message from realistic viewing distance through an exceptional headline, strong hero visual, restrained copy, clear brand presence, and premium placement-aware design?

score_criteria.2: Award 2 only if the advertisement is visually exceptional and genuinely ready for physical placement: the headline and brand read instantly from a distance; one memorable idea dominates; the hero image is striking, relevant, and expertly cropped; supporting copy is minimal and legible; the tall shelter proportions are used intentionally; and typography, contrast, spacing, image quality, and finish feel like a professionally art-directed campaign. There must be no small-copy dependence, generic stock-template appearance, weak focal point, awkward crop, clutter, malformed text, or visible production defect. Anything less than highly polished campaign work cannot receive 2.
score_criteria.1: Award 1 if the advertisement is understandable, attractive enough, and plausibly usable, but it has visible limitations such as too much copy, ordinary imagery, modest headline scale, generic campaign styling, weak long-distance contrast, or underdeveloped brand integration.
score_criteria.0: Award 0 even if it looks like an advertisement when it fails at realistic viewing distance or looks conspicuously low quality: the message is not immediate, headline is too small, hero visual is weak or poorly cropped, layout is cluttered, branding is unclear, or the design requires major redevelopment. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, clipped, or broken outputs are also 0.
